name: churn_risk
title: Churn risk (fictional app)
what_it_tests: Churn risk score + two objective signals (mentions a competitor, asks for a discount) in customer messages for fictional subscription services.

risk.instructions: How close the customer is to canceling

criteria.summary: Unhappy about something specific, but wants to stay

mentions_competitor.instructions: The customer mentions a competing service

asks_discount.instructions: The customer asks for a discount or a better deal to stay
